instruction: A vertical stacked-cube totem carved as a howling wolf head atop a squared pillar, every feature made of visible 1-unit voxels with hard stair-stepped edges. Slate-grey and charcoal cubes form the muzzle and ears, with two glowing cyan voxels for eyes and cream voxels for bared fangs. The base pillar is banded in ochre and umber blocks with a notched pixel pattern.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Voxel Wolf Totem in a voxel/pixel style. A vertical stacked-cube totem carved as a howling wolf head atop a squared pillar, every feature made of visible 1-unit voxels with hard stair-stepped edges. Slate-grey and charcoal cubes form the muzzle and ears, with two glowing cyan voxels for eyes and cream voxels for bared fangs. The base pillar is banded in ochre and umber blocks with a notched pixel pattern. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
